scope: Installation and commissioning of a selected factory-assembled potable-water booster skid in an existing prepared room. The ordinary route accepts only skid count and identity, hydraulic duty and measured suction, discharge and power-cable connection routes. Pump configuration, skid dimensions and mass, accessories, anchors, grout, electrical-controls, testing, labor, mechanisms, procurement balance and logistics are calculated through a visible editable preliminary manufacturer profile.
calculationPrinciples: pump units and included accessories follow the selected skid profile, not separate ordinary questions
anchors and grout are calculated from skid footprint and visible anchor and grout-spacing rules
labor and mechanisms follow calculated equipment, connections, grout and cable quantities
power-cable order is recalculated from measured route, loss, spare, available stock and supplier drum length
room ventilation upgrade, floor strengthening and standby generation remain fail-closed
exclusions: freestanding station building, excavation and external networks
claim that the preliminary profile is an approved universal norm
